A '''Gate Coupling'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''gate coupler'''<ref name="XWRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> was a bonded lock coupler that held the [[Laser tip/Legends|laser tip]] and [[Magnetic flashback suppressor/Legends|magnetic flashback suppressor]] in perfect alignment with the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. The Coupling allowed ground crews to quickly replace the laser tip and flashback suppressor. They were nearly as expensive to purchase as the tip and suppressor combined.<ref name="SWS" />
